summary: Holding his chest, Neo struggles to his feet at one end of the hall while the three Agents wait for the elevator. Agent Smith glances back, rips off his sunglasses, and stares at Neo "as though he were gazing upon a specter." As Neo rises, all three Agents grab for their guns and fire as one, prompting Neo to cry "No!" He raises his hands and the bullets "slow and come to a stop," hanging "suspended motionless, gleaming like metallic constellations." The Agents cannot comprehend what they see. Neo plucks one bullet from the air, studies his reflection in it, then drops it, letting the rest fall to the floor. He now looks out "able to see through the veil of the Matrix," and for a moment the walls, floor, and even the Agents dissolve into "a rushing stream of code."

minds.wants: To stop the killing — to say 'no' to the violence aimed at him and make it stop.
minds.feels: A dawning, wordless certainty that the world is no longer binding him. The effort that a moment ago was 'struggling to get up' has been replaced by a quiet authority he does not have to fight for. He is not afraid of the guns, and his own lack of fear is the revelation.
minds.shows: A single cry — 'No!' — then calm: he raises his hands, halts the bullets, studies his reflection in one, and lets them drop. He looks out, seeing through the world rather than at it.
minds.basis: He cries 'No!' and raises his hands and the bullets obey; he plucks one, studies his reflection, drops it at will, and then 'able to perceive what lies beyond the Matrix's veil' watches the hall dissolve into code. This follows sc-214, where 'His eyes snap open,' and sc-215's 'It is a miracle. Now get up!'

believes_about.belief: They are no longer what he had to run from; they are part of a structure he can now perceive and therefore no longer be threatened by.
believes_about.wrong_because: He does not yet know they will keep coming, adapt, and hunt him in the world beyond this hall — his immunity here reads as permanent, and the coming events will test whether it is.

believes_about.belief: That he has simply survived — that waking was the end of the danger.
believes_about.wrong_because: What is happening is not survival but transformation into something that operates outside the rules; he is only just beginning to understand what he is.

minds.wants: To finish what he started — to confirm Neo dead and restore the order of the world.
minds.feels: Something he has no category for. He ripped off his sunglasses because he did not trust the lens between him and what he is seeing; the thing he killed is standing up. For the first time he is not the one who comprehends — he is the one confronted by something he cannot process.
minds.shows: A stare 'as though he were gazing upon a specter,' then the reflexive, collective reach for weapons and coordinated fire — the old solution applied to a new problem.
minds.basis: He snatches off his shades, staring at Neo like a specter.,' and as Neo rises he and the other Agents grab their guns and fire as one; afterward they cannot process what they are witnessing.' Earlier, Neo was a corpse Smith had every reason to believe was finished.

believes_about.belief: That Neo is a man — a program-bound anomaly that can be located, shot, and deleted like any other.
believes_about.wrong_because: Neo is now operating from outside the system's rules; gunfire is no longer a solution, and Smith's entire model of what Neo is has just been falsified in front of him.

believes_about.belief: That it is stable, governable, and that he is its enforcing will.
believes_about.wrong_because: Neo now sees it as 'a rushing stream of code,' the same substrate Smith inhabits — the hierarchy that made Smith the watcher and Neo the watched is collapsing.

minds.wants: To act in unison to eliminate the threat, as they always have.
minds.feels: A shared breakdown of certainty. Their coordinated fire is pure training, but the result — bullets frozen, their target untroubled — leaves them with nothing to do but register the impossible. They are agents of a system that has just stopped making sense to them.
minds.shows: They grab for their guns and fire as one, then stand 'unable to absorb what they are seeing' — weapons ready but purpose gone.
minds.basis: 'all three Agents grabbing for [.],' followed by 'The Agents can't process the sight before them.' Their earlier confidence (waiting for the elevator, Smith's casual glance back) frames the shock.

believes_about.belief: That he is a target their combined force can end.
believes_about.wrong_because: The frozen bullets prove the opposite; their unity of action no longer produces the outcome it always has.

connects_back: sc-213: Trinity's declaration of love and her refusal to accept Neo's death — the emotional cause that the film treats as reaching him.
sc-214: 'His eyes snap open' — Neo's resurrection, the physical fact this scene builds on.
sc-215: 'It is a miracle... Now get up!' — the crew's witness to his return, the momentum that carries him into this hall.
The prior state of Neo as a killed man the Agents believed finished — the assumption Smith's 'ghost' reaction overturns.
sets_up: ev-036: Neo's broadcast to the Matrix — his new ability to see the world as code and to operate outside its rules is what lets him seize the phone line and speak to the inhabitants as someone who is no longer bound by the system.
ev-037: The lobby assault — the confidence and power displayed here (stopping bullets, perceiving the code) is the footing from which Neo and Trinity walk into open combat with the building's guards.
dramatic_function: It converts Neo's resurrection from an emotional miracle into a shift in the rules of the world, transferring power and knowledge from the Agents to Neo in a single gesture — the moment the hunted stops being governable and the enforcers are left staring at something their system cannot process.
